captions.detailed: A classic benchtop monocular laboratory microscope styled in black, silver, and gold. It features a heavy rectangular base with rounded corners, a vertical support arm, a flat rectangular stage with spring clips holding a slide, and a straight vertical observation tube. The observation tube is mounted on a carriage that slides vertically along a guide on the arm, and it includes a revolving nosepiece with multiple objective lenses and a pair of horizontal focus knobs.
captions.instruction: Generate a parametric model of a benchtop monocular laboratory microscope. The model should include a heavy rounded rectangular base, a vertical support pillar, a rectangular stage with slide clips, and a vertically adjustable optical tube carriage. Incorporate a revolving nosepiece with multiple objective lenses, a pair of coaxial focus knobs on a horizontal shaft, and use a dark black finish for the main body with contrasting metallic silver and brass/gold accents for the optical components.
captions.factory: Construct the microscope by first building the base as a rounded box primitive and the vertical pillar as an extruded rectangular profile. Create the stage with a central circular aperture and attach two thin rectangular spring clips. For the optical assembly, construct a cylindrical focus shaft with larger knurled knob cylinders on each end, a vertical guide rod, and a sliding carriage block. Model the main observation tube and eyepiece as concentric cylinders, and add a rotating nosepiece disc at the bottom carrying multiple smaller cylindrical objective lenses of varying lengths.
